summary: Backend-only verification of P1/P2/P3 shipment: Bulk Re-Enrich (gaps_only + progress movement fix), RunPod auto-sync daemon, Qwen failure dashboard, Chrome extension CRX auto-update infrastructure, plus regression checks. 24/24 integration tests PASS end-to-end against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

minor.issue: For Ramakant labeled-layout, response fills current_company='19 Years' and current_designation='Current CTC' (regex pulled label tokens into company/designation slots). Does NOT affect the fields explicitly asked for (exp, ctc, ectc, notice, name, email, phone all correct), but the company/designation fallback is wrong on labeled layouts and leaks into work_experience[0]. Consider blacklisting label tokens ('Experience', 'Current CTC', 'Notice Period', '19 Years', etc.) in company/designation regex.

401 when only Authorization header is sent; requires ?token= query param. Works fine with either Bearer header OR token query — but the error message 'Pass ?token= for new-tab downloads' implies header-only is rejected. Verified in test that ?token= works (307 to R2). Low priority — documented behaviour, not a bug.

action_items: Optional: sanitise company/designation regex on /api/extension/ai-extract so labeled Naukri top-cards don't bleed 'Experience'/'19 Years'/'Current CTC' into work_experience[0].
critical_code_review_comments: routes/candidates.py is 2966 lines — exceeds 700-line ceiling. Bulk-re-enrich + failed-capture-recovery + deletion endpoints should be split into dedicated modules.

routes/extension_updates.py reads /app/browser-extension/manifest.json synchronously inside every /latest-version and /checkin request (blocks the event loop for <1ms but still sync I/O inside async). Cache on startup is trivial and preferable.

admin_monitoring.py uses literal admin@vhc.in check via _require_admin role-based gate (good) — but failure-stats/live-banner pipeline builds a new datetime cutoff comparing ISO strings which works only because created_at is stored as ISO (lexicographic sort == chronological). Document this invariant or switch to BSON dates.
runpod_sync_service.py get_snapshot must be idempotent and thread-safe — verify the module-level state dict is not mutated during an in-flight request.

extension_updates.py checkin endpoint has NO size/shape validation on body.version or body.install_type beyond .strip()[:32]. Accepted: any string. Consider regex gate like ^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$ for version to keep version-stats buckets clean.
bulk-re-enrich endpoint does NOT persist the job_id back into individual candidate_bank rows — so you cannot go from a candidate to 'which job last touched me'. Minor observability gap.
